title: Custom electric motor controller
summary: An STM32 motor controller with a custom half-bridge board and resolver feedback.
overview: Control signals from the STM32 drive a custom half-bridge board, which drives the motor. A resolver connected to the motor feeds back into the STM32, closing the control loop.
components: STM32G474 microcontroller with timer PWM outputs, shown in the pinout.
Custom half-bridge PCB with high-voltage and gate-drive circuitry.
Resolver feeding motor feedback into the STM32.

diagram.alt: STM32 control to half-bridge board to motor to resolver, with resolver feedback returning to the STM32.

hero.alt: Custom half-bridge PCB layout showing high-voltage switching components, gate-drive circuitry, and PWM inputs.
hero.caption: Half-bridge PCB layout / power switching and gate-drive circuitry

images.alt: STM32G474RETx pinout with TIM1 PWM outputs, complementary outputs, SPI1, and SWD pins highlighted.
